'''Yanille''' (pronounced ''"ya-NEEL"''){{CitePostbag|issue = 35|letter =Letter 4|author=Reldo}} is a [[members]]-only city south of [[Ardougne]], known for hosting [[Wizards' Guild]]. Due to the threat of [[ogre]]s from nearby [[Gu'Tanoth]], the city is surrounded by tall walls, and is heavily patrolled by guards.

==Transportation==
A number of methods exist for teleporting to or near Yanille:
*{{Plink|Teleport to House}} — Yanille [[house portal]]. Requires a [[POH]] there.
**{{Plink|Construct. cape|txt=Construction cape}} or {{plink|Yanille teleport}} — Yanille [[Portal (Player-owned house)|house portal]].
*{{plink|Minigame Teleport}} — [[Nightmare Zone]], just outside the eastern entrance.
*{{Plink|Watchtower Teleport|txt=Watchtower teleport}} — Watchtower. After completing Ardougne Hard Diary, the teleport can be switched to the centre of Yanille.
*{{Plink|Fairy ring|pic=Fairy ring (Construction) icon}} {{fairycode|CLS}} — behind [[Hazelmere]]'s home on the [[Yanille Chain]].
*{{Plink|Fairy ring|pic=Fairy ring (Construction) icon}} {{fairycode|CIQ}} — north of the [[Unnamed island (north of Gu'Tanoth)|ogre island]], just outside the western entrance.
*{{Plink|Khazard Teleport|txt=Khazard teleport}} — [[Port Khazard]], a good run north-east of the city.
*{{Plink|Ring of dueling}} to Castle Wars — the [[Castle Wars]] lobby, well west of the city.
** Or {{plink|Minigame Teleport}} — Castle Wars if the one for Nightmare Zone is locked
*{{Plink|Gnome glider|pic=Gnome goggles}} — Feldip Hills, well south of the city.
*{{Plink|Spirit trees|pic=Spirit tree (Construction) icon}} — centre of [[Tree Gnome Village (location)|Tree Gnome Village]]. Players must first follow [[Elkoy]] out of the maze, then complete a long run south-east.
*{{Plink|Ardougne cloak 1}} or higher — the [[Ardougne Monastery]], well north of the city.

== History ==
{{LoreSources|Watchtower|Postbag from the Hedge|Watchtower Wizard|Colonel Radick|Eastern Discovery|dialogue3=yes|the3=yes|dialogue4=yes}}

It is unknown what year Yanille was founded, but it was originally built by both soldiers and mages.{{CitePostbag|issue = 11|letter = Wise old tips|author=Wise Old Man}} At some point, an ancient spell was placed to ward off ogres by the Watchtower Wizard, sustained by a crystal-powered machine. At some point, the crystals powering the machine broke, until an adventurer helped fix them.

There has been ongoing tension in the city due to the threat of ogres in the area. While gnomes and humans were able to sign a treaty of peace with the elves following the [[God Wars]], the ogres of Gu'Tanoth didn't sign. In the time since then, operations have been largely defensive; however, in the year 169, a [[H.A.M.]] member saw this conflict as a reason [[Zogre Flesh Eaters#Incriminating Sithik|to try to destroy the nearby ogre burial ground of Jiggig]].

He will automatically deliver it to players who have completed the elite [[Ardougne Diary]].

|A building containing a staircase leading down. The basement has [[Door (Yanille Agility Dungeon)|a pickable door leading into the Yanille dungeon]], requiring 82 [[Thieving]].

=== Skill training areas ===

* Just west of Bert's house is a [[Portal (Player-owned house)|house portal]]. Players with 50 [[Construction]] can pay any [[estate agent]] 25,000 [[coins]] to move their house here. This location is popular due to it closeness to the bank.
* The [[Fight Arena mine]] is located north-east of the city. It is one of the closest mines to a bank, and provides excellent experience for [[Mining|miners]] wishing to get levels quickly.
* There are two [[anvil]]s are just south of the bank in the anvil building. [[Smithing]] [[runite limbs]] here is part of a task for the [[Ardougne_Diary#Elite|elite Ardougne Diary]].
* The [[hops patch]] next to the guest house is used in the [[Farming]] skill. It is watched over by [[Selena]].
* A number of [[Tree|regular]] and [[Oak tree|oak trees]] can be found inside and outside the walls of the city.
* Nightmare Zone, a combat-focused minigame, can be found next to the eastern entrance.
* The [[Yanille Agility Dungeon|Yanille Agility dungeon]], a dangerous dungeon where players can earn herbs for training [[Herblore]]. The dungeon can either be entered from the building north of the city, which requires slashing a [[Web|spider web]] with a sharp blade or knife, or from the [[Door (Yanille Agility Dungeon)|door]] in the basement of the building just south of the bank, requiring 82 [[Thieving]].
[[File:Unnamed island (north of Gu'Tanoth).png|thumb|The [[Unnamed island (north of Gu'Tanoth)|ogre island]] just outside the gates of Yanille.]]

=== Other ===

* The archipelago to the east of Yanille is home to many [[jungle spider]]s. [[Hazelmere]], the [[gnome]] mage, may be found up a ladder here. The {{Fairycode|cls}} [[fairy ring]] can also be found behind Hazelmere's house.
* The [[Unnamed island (north of Gu'Tanoth)|ogre island]] west of Yanille has jangerberry and bone spawns, as well as many [[Safespot|safespottable]] [[Ogre|ogres]].
* There is an [[Agility]] [[Shortcuts|shortcut]] under the north wall of Yanille, somewhat near the Watchtower, that requires 16 Agility to use.

==Inhabitants==
===Personalities===
*{{Chatl|Aleck}}, who sells [[Hunter gear|Hunter equipment]].
*3 {{Chatl|Banker|text=bankers|pic=Banker (male) chathead}}, who facilitate access to the [[Bank of Gielinor]].
*{{Chatl|Bartender (Dragon Inn)|text=Bartender}}, who offers both [[beer]] and gossip.
*{{Chatl|Bert}}, a sand-obsessed resident with a [[Sand pit|sandpit]] outside his home.
*{{Chatl|Colonel Radick}}, a high-ranking member of Yanille's guard.
*{{Chatl|Frenita}}, who runs a [[Frenita's Cookery Shop.|Cooking shop]].
*{{Chatl|Leon}}, a strange man who entered [[Aleck]]'s store to sell [[Hunters' crossbow|a Hunter item of his own]].
*{{Chatl|Guard Captain|text=Guard captain}}, who is too drunk to control his words, let alone his troops.
*{{Chatl|Hazelmere}}, a wise old [[Gnome (race)|gnome]] who played a part in creating the [[Grand Tree]].
*{{Chatl|Selena}}, a gardener who looks after the hops patch for a fee.
*{{Chatl|Sithik Ints}}, a prejudiced wizard who is now bedridden.
*{{Chatl|Sigbert the Adventurer}}, an adventurous knight who was unable to defeat the evil wizard in the Yanille dungeon.
*The{{Chatl|Tramp (pillory)|text=tramp}}, a man down on his luck.
*{{Chatl|Tool Leprechaun|text=Tool leprechaun}}, a green-clad fellow who can store gardening supplies and [[Bank note|note]] produce.
*The {{Chatl|Watchtower Wizard|text=watchtower wizard}} and the other {{Chatl|Wizard (Watchtower)|text=wizards accompanying him|pic=Wizard (Watchtower, 2) chathead}}, who reside in the [[Watchtower (building)|Watchtower]] overlooking the southern hills.
*[[Wizards' Guild]]:
**{{Chatl|Wizard Akutha}}, who runs the guild's [[Magic Guild Store (Runes and Staves)|rune shop]].
**{{Chatl|Wizard Distentor}}, the guildleader, capable of teleporting players to the [[rune essence mine]].
**{{Chatl|Wizard Frumscone}}, a wizard who summons [[Safespot|safespottable]] [[Zombie|zombies]] in the guild basement.
**{{Chatl|Wizard Sinina}}, who [[Magic Guild Store (Mystic Robes)|sells mystic robes]].
**{{Chatl|Zavistic Rarve}}, the guild's secretary and a part of multiple [[quests]].

=== Monsters or attackable NPCs ===
*[[Chaos druid]] (x11) - deep in the Yanille dungeon
*[[Chaos druid warrior]] (x9) - in the early parts of the Yanille dungeon
*[[Colonel Radick]] - between the gates at the west wall
*[[Cow]] (x4) - just north of Yanille wall.
*[[Dwarf]] (x4) - to the south of the city.
*[[Giant bat]] (x8) - in the basement with the lockpickable door.
*[[Imp]] (x8) - just north-east of the city and inside the city
*[[Jungle spider]] (x21) - on the [[Yanille Chain]].
*[[Man]] (x2) - in the guest house.
*[[Ogre]] (x14) - west of Yanille
*[[Poison spider]] (x18) - in the lowest level of the Yanille dungeon.
*[[Salarin the twisted]] - at the end of the Yanille dungeon.
*[[Skeleton]] (x6) - in a side cave of the Yanille dungeon.
*[[Soldier (Yanille)|Soldier]] (x26) - all along the walls of Yanille, including up the stairs at the west gate.
*[[Tower guard]] (x5) - upstairs at the west gate.
*[[Unicorn]] (x2) - to the south of the wall.
*[[Watchman]] (x4) - in the Watchtower.
*[[Wizard]] (x8) - inside the Wizards' Guild
*[[Zombie]] (x8) - under Wizards' Guild

==Quests==
*[[The Hand in the Sand]] - Can be started east of the sandbox.
*[[Swan Song]] - Involves the [[Wizards' Guild]].
*[[Wanted!]] - The Dragon Inn is the answer to the [[greenman's ale]] clue.
*[[Watchtower]] - Started just outside the north-west wall of Yanille.
*[[Zogre Flesh Eaters]] - Involves the [[Wizards' Guild]].
